canonical_title: Probability of degraded flying qualities due to failures

versions.title_at_revision: Primary flying qualities for failure states
versions.text: Criterion: Verify that the primary requirements for Failure States have been defined and assessed for safety of flight. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within the following MIL-STD-1797 paragraphs: a. 5.1.1.3 Primary requirements for failure states. b. 5.1.1.3.1 Probability of encountering degraded levels of flying qualities due to failures. c. 5.1.1.3.2 Allowable Levels for specific air vehicle failure states. Table IX is completed. d. 5.1.1.3.3 Failures outside the ROTH. For rotorcraft, the air vehicle meets standards within ADS-33-PRF, 3.1.14 Rotorcraft failures. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, simulation, and inspection of requirements, design, and configuration documentation.

versions.title_at_revision: Probability of degraded flying qualities due to failures
versions.text:
Standard: In no case can a failure state (except a special failure state) degrade flying qualities to worse than Level 3. In calm air, the overall probability of encountering Level 2 flying qualities due to one or more failures is less than 10-5 per flight hour within the ROSH, and the overall probability of encountering Level 3 flying qualities due to one or more failures is less than 10-6 per flight hour within the ROSH and less than 10-3 per flight hour within the ROTH. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct FMECA to assess the overall probability of encountering Level 2 flying/handling qualities due to one or more failures within the ROSH, and the overall probability of encountering Level 3 flying/handling qualities due to one or more failures within the ROSH and within the ROTH. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct FMET to assess the overall probability of encountering Level 2 flying/handling qualities due to one or more failures within the ROSH, and the overall probability of encountering Level 3 flying/handling qualities due to one or more failures within the ROSH and within the ROTH.
  (2) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation, including open-loop flying qualities maneuvers and closed-loop handling qualities tasks, to assess flying/handling qualities for the failure states for each combination of regions of handling qualities, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (3) Flight test: Conduct flight test, including open-loop flying qualities maneuvers and closed-loop handling qualities tasks, to assess flying qualities for the failure states for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
